name: Nuvio Anime Torrents (SeaDex + NekoBT)
description: Two independent torrent providers for NuvioTV. SeaDex (seadex.moe) returns curated best releases and season batches aimed at the exact episode file; NekoBT (nekobt.to) returns the releases indexed by the tracker. Both return 1080p and above only.
author: Nuvio Community

scrapers.name: SeaDex Torrents
scrapers.description: Per-episode torrents from SeaDex (seadex.moe), keyed by AniList id; 1080p and above only, including season batches targeted at the exact episode file

scrapers.name: NekoBT Torrents
scrapers.description: Per-episode torrents from nekobt.to, resolved to the exact show by TMDB id; 1080p and above only, at least one seeder, multi-episode batches excluded
